title: WAREHOUSE/THEME PARK
content: I've been having recurring dreams of a very peculiar space. It's like a huge warehouse with different interconnected rooms with different "themes". I've been through doors that have strobe lights and "haunted house" type imagery. Another room was a bridge in a black void with huge grandfather clocks ringing everywhere. Once I crawled through an "employees only" maintenance hatch, and wound up an a modern suburban home, with an overwhelming feeling like I wasnt supposed to be there. One of the weirder ones, I was falling through all sorts of violent machinery with rollers and spikes, only for the vision to fade/transition into TV screens, which lined the walls of a room resembling some kind of daycare center. A lot of the spaces have a "movie set" or theme park vibe, similar to the Meow Wolf exhibits if you've seen them. The only time I've seen the outside of this warehouse, it was like a carnival, with other warehouses that had different attractions. The buildings all had screens outside that were playing images of birth, surgery, medical stuff. That's pretty much it, super weird and hard to explain every aspect of it, but it feels like a "realer" version of those Meow Wolf/Area 15 art spaces.
